user.title: Xiaomi Camera Native
user.description: Experimental direct MISS/CS2 camera streaming. Sign in to the same region used in Mi Home.

menu_options.token: Use an existing Mi Home account credential

login.title: Xiaomi account
login.description: Your password is used for this login only. A reusable account credential is stored by Home Assistant.

data.username: Email, phone number or Xiaomi ID

token.title: Existing Mi Home credential
token.description: Enter your numeric Xiaomi account ID and the account passToken. This is the account credential from the xiaomi section of go2rtc.yaml, not a camera's 32-character device token. Do not share it.

captcha.title: Xiaomi CAPTCHA
captcha.description:
Enter the characters shown in the image.

![Xiaomi CAPTCHA]({captcha_image})

verification.title: Xiaomi verification
verification.description: Xiaomi sent a verification code to {destination}.

cameras.title: Select cameras
cameras.description: CS2 cameras are supported in this experimental release. If a camera has no local IP, set it in the integration's camera options before opening live view.

error.invalid_auth: Xiaomi rejected the login or verification code. Check your account and region, or use a valid Mi Home passToken.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Xiaomi. Check Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_captcha: Enter the new CAPTCHA shown below.
error.invalid_host: Enter the camera's local IPv4 address.

abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same Xiaomi account and region as this integration.
abort.no_cameras: No cameras were found in this Xiaomi account region.
abort.discovery_failed: Camera discovery failed. Check the account region and try again.
abort.reauth_required: Reauthenticate the integration before discovering cameras.

profile.title: Configure {camera}
profile.description: Automatically recover a changed IP from matching Home Assistant router trackers or Xiaomi discovery. Turn automatic updates off to keep a fixed IP. H.264 uses FFmpeg; the height setting applies to H.264 only.

rediscover.title: Select cameras
rediscover.description: Select the cameras to expose in Home Assistant. Existing entity IDs are retained for cameras that stay selected.
